description: Customer profile with the given name that is associated with the store, so a coupon created with All Profiles off can be attached to it (outputs its profile id). KB: Managing Store Profiles (associated, default anonymous and registered profiles); Configuring a Promotion (Profile).

profile.description: Profile name as Znode stores it (ZnodeProfile.ProfileName), e.g. the store's anonymous or retail customer profile; usually the same value as the coupon key's profile param

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); the profile must be associated with this store
